9/S0.subgoal: Explain the high-level goals and types of issues (technological and psychological) in virtual reality.

9/S1.subgoal: Compare the two major conceptual approaches to 'reality' in VR—matching lived experience versus surpassing it.

9/S2.subgoal: Explain the uncanny valley effect and the trade-off it presents in VR design.

9/S3.subgoal: Describe the different types of fidelity (representational, interaction, and experiential) used to achieve presence.

9/S4.subgoal: Summarize the major technological and psychological challenges of virtual reality.

9/S5.subgoal: Identify the essential characteristics that define an augmented reality system.

9/S6.subgoal: Describe the challenges related to combining content and achieving interaction in AR systems.

9/S7.subgoal: Explain how registration and tracking determine the seamless integration of virtual content in AR.

9/S8.subgoal: Compare and contrast the major issues and challenges faced in VR versus AR systems.
